headline: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited: Q1 FY2026-27 Monitoring Agency Report Filed
sum: CARE Ratings files Q1 monitoring agency report for PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery's IPO proceeds utilisation, confirming post-listing compliance tracking as of 30 June 2026.
detail: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited, having completed a public issue of equity shares, filed its Q1 FY2026-27 monitoring agency report via NSE on 6 August 2026. CARE Ratings Limited, the statutory monitoring agency, tracked utilisation of IPO proceeds for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. This is a regulatory compliance requirement under SEBI's Ichalkaranji Board of Trade IPO guidelines.
